BuilderProfile.title: BuilderProfile
BuilderProfile.description: Per-user builder profile and aggregate gameplay progression stats.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Builder display name shown in the hub and profile.

totalBlocksMined.description: Lifetime blocks mined across all worlds.

totalBlocksPlaced.description: Lifetime blocks placed across all worlds.

totalItemsCrafted.description: Lifetime items crafted across all worlds.

builderLevel.description: Calculated builder progression level starting at 1.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon profile creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every save.

VoxelWorld.title: VoxelWorld
VoxelWorld.description: Cloud-saved 3D voxel sandbox world storing seed, biome, mode, player position, block deltas, inventory, and hotbar.

biome.description: Procedural biome type used to generate base terrain.

gameMode.description: Gameplay mode determining inventory limits, flying, and mining progression.

seed.description: Deterministic integer seed for procedural terrain generation.

timeOfDay.description: Normalized day-night cycle position from 0.0 to 1.0.

pickaxeTier.description: Current pickaxe tier (1 = Wood, 2 = Iron, 3 = Diamond).

blocksMined.description: Total blocks mined in this world.

blocksPlaced.description: Total blocks placed in this world.

playerX.description: Last saved player X world coordinate.

playerY.description: Last saved player Y world coordinate.

playerZ.description: Last saved player Z world coordinate.

blockDeltas.description: Native map of modified coordinates ('x,y,z') to integer block IDs (0 = air).

inventory.description: Native map of BlockType names to integer stack quantities.

hotbar.description: Ordered list of up to 9 BlockType names equipped in the player's hotbar.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon world creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every save.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated builder profile and lifetime gameplay statistics.

/users/{userId}/worlds/{worldId}.description: Owner-isolated collection of cloud-saved 3D voxel worlds.
